placements.title: A person receives one bundle per run, not a message per skill
placements.frame: What does a person receive from a run, what closes it, and who bears the burden of ordering and collapsing the pieces?
placements.why: The ruling concerns how reaction delivery is shaped for the reader: one bundle per run per person, closed with the run, with per-skill delivery rejected. Future delivery rulings could keep feeding this theme. No existing leaf holds it, because decision capture at consensus, decisions evaporating and anti-Slack positioning concern capturing decisions, not routing reactions. I override the position pass's proposed placement under Narrative_DecisionCaptureAtConsensus.

mints.name: ReactionDeliveryRouting
mints.title: How reactions reach a person: bundling per run, when the bundle closes, and where ordering is resolved
mints.why: The envelope's content is about one subject, delivery routing of reactions, which later rulings are likely to keep returning to.

connections.why: The leaf is the theme of how reactions are delivered to a person.
The position holds the bundling rule, the batching-window dispute and the rejected alternative, all of which are about delivery routing.
